messages:
Sanjeev: Heads up — kicking off a short thread about a 'quota-orbit' pattern. idea: pin tenant quotas to regional "orbits" to limit cross-region abuse and improve locality. want quick tradeoffs + who owns the interfaces.
Maria: tl;dr — sounds promising for locality and cost isolation, but risks creating unfair burst behavior for multi-orbit apps. we need clear fallback rules.
Devin: can we do this as an admission shim only? keep the token ledger unchanged, just route and short-circuit admission decisions at edge. fewer ledger changes.
Lee: i prefer the router/edge config approach. if it's purely routing + policy, central quota service shouldn't need schema changes. ops side should be able to flip flags.
Amanda: big question: where do abuse signals live? orbit routing should not be the canonical blacklist. we need replication of abuse scores or an async subscription feed. otherwise orbits will diverge.
Sanjeev: agree. my sketch: admission shim consults quota-service for an "orbit allowance" (fast RPC), falls back to a global pool on miss/deny. shim adds an "X-Orbit-Penalty" header when a penalty is applied.
Sanjeev: quick config sketch:
```
# pseudo edge config
orbit_policy:
  enabled: true
  fallback: global_pool
  penalty_window_seconds: 300
  abuse_threshold: 0.9
  cache_ttl_ms: 50
```
Maria: that extra RPC is the latency tradeoff. even with 50ms cache_ttl, tail latency could jump. need perf numbers before rolling wide.
Devin: cache tokens at edge with compare-and-decrement semantics, TTL 50ms-200ms depending on region. add eviction hooks so we never overspend.
Lee: telemetry must include: orbit_id, fallback_reason (e.g., global_pool|quota_miss|abuse), penalty_applied=true/false. add a per-orbit SLO dashboard.
Amanda: owners: eng-platform -> header+observability; eng-infra -> edge cache & shim primitive; eng-security -> abuse model + feed. agree?
Sanjeev: yep. i'll draft a short RFC that defines the shim interface (AdmitRequest { tenant, orbit_id, cost_estimate }) and expected responses (AdmitResponse { allow, fallback, penalty_hint }). keep response tiny.
Devin: for prototyping i'll implement shim with only admit+cache and a flag to bubble to global pool on deny. no ledger changes.
Maria: add a small eval: 5 tenants across 2 orbits, 1 noisy tenant. measure fairness (p99 latency, token allocation) before/after.
Sanjeev: action items: (1) i file RFC + interface sketch; (2) devin protos shim prototype next sprint; (3) lee/infra add telemetry tags; (4) amanda/security define feed contract. @ops-bot can you spin up canary?
ops-bot: Canary created: r-orbit-canary-3. ready for deploy when you are :white_check_mark:
Devin: will push a WIP PR and ping this thread. keeping it small and feature-flagged.
Maria: :thumbsup: if we see fairness regressions we can rollback the shim quickly. keep the eval harness handy.
Sanjeev: great, thanks everyone. i'll link RFC here when it's up.
